"I Love New York" was written and composed by Steve Karmen in 1977 as part of the advertising campaign.
In 1980, Governor Hugh Carey declared it as New York's state anthem.
In a move that was remarkable for Karmen, who is well known for retaining the publishing rights to his songs, he gave the rights to the song to the state for free.
The logo has become a pop-culture icon, inspiring imitations in every corner of the globe.
